why: अर्षाभि = अर्ष + अभि (sandhi); 'sa no arṣābhi dūtyam' is grammatical and metrical.
मोपरि = मा + उपरि, contrasting with अधः पश्यस्व.
इद्विन्द्र = इत् + उ + इन्द्र (u+i → vi), a regular Samhita sandhi.
वरेयं (to woo) fits the wedding context 'vareyaṃ sūryām upa'.
दीदिवः is the vocative of दीदिवस् (shining), agreeing with पावक and अग्ने.
देवावा = देवौ + आ (dual before vowel), 'aśvinau devāv ā dhattām'.
विश्वाति = विश्वा + अति, 'parṣad viśvāti duritā' is the standard phrase.
विश्वाति = विश्वा + अति, 'sa hi viśvāti pārthivā rayiṃ dāśat' is grammatical.
अघ्न्येयं = अघ्न्या + इयं, the cow of the preceding lines.
अच्छायं = अच्छा + अयं, parallel to the second अच्छा in the same line.
अग्रियं (first portion) qualifies मध्वः; a regular Rigvedic word.
यथानः = यथा + अनः (cart); 'uṣaso yathānaḥ' is a sound simile.
यथासो = यथा + असः (asas, 2sg subjunctive), 'gṛhapatnī yathāso'.
अन्त्यग्ने = अन्ति + अग्ने, contrasting with दूरे earlier in the line.
यद्यज्ञं = यत् + यज्ञं; regular sandhi.
तत्तव = तत् + तव; regular sandhi.
तमव = तम् + अव (ava hantana), grammatical.
वर्मणो (armour) is the subject of the hymn, cf. यद्वर्मी in the previous line.
अन्त्यस्मे = अन्ति + अस्मे, contrasting with आरात्तात् later in the line.
एतवा (infinitive etavai before vowel) with अस्तु पन्थाः is grammatical.
तन्नेव = तत् + न + इव (Vedic neva), fits 'yadi tan neva haryatha'.
स्वतवः (self-strong, vocative) is a regular epithet.
कितव (gambler, vocative) matches the gambling hymn context (अक्षैर्मा दीव्यः).
शमस्य pairs with शृङ्गिणः (hornless and horned); सोमस्य would not fit.
सोममस्य = सोमम् + अस्य, 'apibaḥ somam asya' is grammatical.
तामस्य = ताम् + अस्य, agreeing with रीतिं.
किमस्य = किम् + अस्य, repeated three times in the line.
समस्य = सम् + अस्य (sam namanta), grammatical.
त्वमस्य = त्वम् + अस्य (tvam asya pāhi), grammatical.
श्रमस्य दायं (share of toil) is a sensible phrase; not सोमस्य.
Unaccented enclitic यथा after अङ्कुशं: svarita on य after udatta शं, anudatta on था before udatta शक् is consistent.
इदिह = इत् + इह; regular sandhi.
इवेह = इव + इह, 'indra iveha dhruvas tiṣṭha'.
अथाद्य = अथ + अद्य; regular sandhi.
अस्त्वद्य = अस्तु + अद्य; regular sandhi.
धीतये (for insight) fits 'pra vaḥ sa dhītaye naśat'; पीतये would not.
इयमा = इयम् + आ, agreeing with ऊतिः.
त्सातये is the edition's n+s → nts sandhi after मघवन् (cf. प्रचरन् त्स्वे, अभूवन् त्स्वस्ति nearby).
रातये (for giving) parallels ऊतये in the same line.
इषमा = इषम् + आ (iṣam ā vakṣi), grammatical.
व्रतस्य with अदब्धस्य is a regular phrase.
दूतस्य (messenger) is a stock epithet of Agni, cf. अग्नेः in the line.
ततस्य (of the father) matches शिरस्ततस्य in the preceding verse.
पूतस्य (purified soma) with पिबन्ति is a regular phrase.
श्रीतस्य (mixed soma) alongside सुतस्य is regular; trailing १५ is the edition's group number.
भूतस्य प्रचेतसः (knowers of what exists) is grammatical.
मा शेषसा मा तनसा (neither offspring nor progeny) is a known pair; मनसा would not fit.

suggest: आ या॑हि॒ वन॑सा स॒ह गाव॑: सचन्त वर्त॒निं यदूध॑भिः।१
why: वनसा is fine, but the line opens with a svarita on या with no preceding udatta and the pāda is a syllable short; the next verse opens आ या॑हि॒, so initial आ is missing.
सुव्रतः (of good vows) with राजेव is a regular epithet.
जीवान् (the living) is the object of शाधि; देवान् would not fit the sense.
सत्सीह = सत्सि + इह (satsi iha devaiḥ), regular sandhi.
आर्यस्य (of the Arya) fits the battle narrative with तृत्सुभ्यः.
पिपृता (2pl imperative of pṛ, carry across) governs निरंहसः.
अधाहं = अध + अहं; regular sandhi.
महिष (bull, vocative) is an Indra epithet alongside उग्र.
महिन (vocative, great one) alongside इन्द्र is a regular epithet.
इहि (imperative of i, go) in 'pra gā ihi' is grammatical.
गन्वहि (1st dual subjunctive of gam, 'let us two go') pairs with सचेवहि in the next pāda.
ष्विन्द्र = षु + इन्द्र after हविरो (haviro ṣv indra), regular sandhi.
इदिन्द्र = इत् + इन्द्र; regular sandhi.
